title: Canadian Syncope Risk Score
subtitle: 30-day serious outcome risk after ED assessment
summary: The final ED diagnosis and troponin are part of the validated score, so a complete prehospital calculation is not possible.
population: Clinical features, systolic BP, ECG axis/QRS/QTc measurements, troponin and the final ED diagnostic impression.
exclusions: Do not enter assumed normal results.
overrides: Follow the applicable NICE, local emergency department or specialty pathway.
limitations: The final ED diagnosis and troponin are part of the validated score, so a complete prehospital calculation is not possible.

clinicalValidation.reviewNotes: Formal clinical verification has not yet been recorded. Population, exclusions, thresholds, calculations, wording and implementation tests must be checked against the cited source.
